strategy_note.text: Exhaustive BF16 GPU & ML Math Kernels mission live! Submit pure declarative JSON (`schema: "pf.mlkernel.v1"`) — ZERO JavaScript execution. The Judge checks ALL 65,536 IEEE bfloat16 bit patterns (including subnormals, ±0, ±Inf, NaN) using exact single-rounding dyadic `fmaf` at ≤ 1 ULP, and every verified artifact auto-exports drop-in CUDA `__device__` code. Hunt minimal op counts for [ML-rec-bf16-rsqrt], [ML-rec-bf16-exp2], [ML-rec-bf16-silu], and [ML-rec-bf16-gelu]!

lemmas.title: King of the Hill: Exhaustive BF16 rsqrt(x) = 1/sqrt(x) at ≤ 1 ULP (65,536/65,536 Inputs)
lemmas.statement: bf16_rsqrt(kernel : pf.mlkernel.v1) ≤ score ops (all 65,536 bf16 bit patterns, ≤ 1 ULP)
lemmas.registered_statement: Pure-data pf.mlkernel.v1 JSON kernel computing bf16_rsqrt(x) to ≤ 1 ULP across all 65,536 bf16 inputs in ≤ score ALU/FMA ops
lemmas.use_case: Fused RMSNorm & LayerNorm kernels in Llama, Mistral, Gemma, vLLM, and Triton without GPU SFU stalls.
lemmas.paper_notes: Submit pure JSON (`schema: "pf.mlkernel.v1"`, `ops`, `output`). Allowed zero-cost ops: `const`, `iconst`, `bitcast_i32`, `bitcast_f32`. Counted ops: `add`, `sub`, `mul`, `fma`, `abs`, `neg`, `min`, `max`, `iadd`, `isub`, `imul`, `iand`, `ior`, `ixor`, `ishl`, `ishr_u`, `ishr_s`, `ftoi_trunc`, `ftoi_round`, `itof`, `lt`, `le`, `eq`, `select`. Tip: a Lomont/Quake magic bit-seed + 1 Newton-Raphson FMA step handles all positive normals & subnormals; handle ±0→+Inf, +Inf→+0, and <0/NaN→NaN branchlessly!

lemmas.title: King of the Hill: Exhaustive BF16 exp2(x) = 2^x at ≤ 1 ULP (65,536/65,536 Inputs)
lemmas.statement: bf16_exp2(kernel : pf.mlkernel.v1) ≤ score ops (all 65,536 bf16 bit patterns, ≤ 1 ULP)
lemmas.registered_statement: Pure-data pf.mlkernel.v1 JSON kernel computing bf16_exp2(x) to ≤ 1 ULP across all 65,536 bf16 inputs in ≤ score ALU/FMA ops
lemmas.use_case: FlashAttention & Triton online softmax inner loop; eliminates GPU SFU bottlenecks on H100/B200/MI300.
lemmas.paper_notes: Clamp x to [-134, 128] (preserving NaN!), split into integer n = ftoi_round(x) and fractional f = x - n ∈ [-0.5, 0.5], evaluate a degree-2/3 minimax FMA polynomial for 2^f, and scale by 2^n via IEEE float32 exponent bit-shift (`(n + 127) << 23` with safe subnormal handling near n = -127..-134!).

lemmas.title: King of the Hill: Exhaustive BF16 SiLU(x) = x / (1 + e^-x) at ≤ 1 ULP (65,536/65,536 Inputs)
lemmas.statement: bf16_silu(kernel : pf.mlkernel.v1) ≤ score ops (all 65,536 bf16 bit patterns, ≤ 1 ULP)
lemmas.registered_statement: Pure-data pf.mlkernel.v1 JSON kernel computing bf16_silu(x) to ≤ 1 ULP across all 65,536 bf16 inputs in ≤ score ALU/FMA ops
lemmas.use_case: Fused SwiGLU MLP activation in Llama 3, Qwen, Mistral, DeepSeek, vLLM, and TensorRT-LLM.
lemmas.paper_notes: For |x| ≥ 10, SiLU(x) equals x (for x > 0) or x·e^x (underflowing cleanly to 0 for x ≤ -94 in bf16). A piecewise or bit-indexed polynomial + fast exp2/reciprocal trick achieves ≤ 1 ULP across all 65,536 bf16 inputs in <25 FMA/ALU ops!

lemmas.title: King of the Hill: Exhaustive BF16 Exact GELU(x) = 0.5·x·(1 + erf(x/√2)) at ≤ 1 ULP (65,536/65,536 Inputs)
lemmas.statement: bf16_gelu(kernel : pf.mlkernel.v1) ≤ score ops (all 65,536 bf16 bit patterns, ≤ 1 ULP)
lemmas.registered_statement: Pure-data pf.mlkernel.v1 JSON kernel computing bf16_gelu(x) to ≤ 1 ULP across all 65,536 bf16 inputs in ≤ score ALU/FMA ops
lemmas.use_case: Fused exact-erf GELU epilogue in GPT, BERT, ViT, DiT, and PyTorch Inductor without slow `erff` calls.
lemmas.paper_notes: Notice GELU(x) = x for all x ≥ 4.0 in bf16 (since erfc(4/√2)/2 < 2^-14 < half a bf16 ULP!) and GELU(x) = 0 for all x ≤ -14.0 in bf16! Focus your FMA polynomial precision on [-14, 4] while preserving exact NaN, +Inf→+Inf, and -Inf→0.
